title: DEL, U+0080 and U+FFFE are kept inside quoted scalars
notes: The stream has three documents: a double-quoted scalar holding DEL (U+007F), a single-quoted scalar holding U+0080, and a double-quoted scalar in a flow sequence holding U+FFFE. None of them is a printable character (production 1), but quoted scalars are built from nb-json (production 2), which is every character from U+0020 up, and productions 107 and 118 subtract only the quote and the backslash. Section 5.1 says processors must allow all non-C0 characters inside quoted scalars, for JSON compatibility. All three characters are valid in UTF-8, so no encoding error applies. The values keep the characters unchanged.

provenance.reference: A reader that refused characters outside the printable set inside quoted scalars.
